adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh request checks `if (response.statusText !== "OK")` and throws. This is brittle because `statusText` is not reliable/consistent across environments (can be empty or non-"OK" for successful 2xx responses), which would incorrectly treat successful token refreshes as failures. Using `response.ok` or `response.status` would avoid this broken behavior.
